# Authon

> Frontend authentication platform — a modern Clerk alternative for JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks + Swift (iOS/macOS).

Authon provides drop-in auth for any framework: OAuth (20 providers), email/password with verification, passwordless (magic link, email OTP), passkeys (WebAuthn), Web3 wallet login (EVM + Solana), TOTP MFA, organizations, session management, webhooks, and a ShadowDOM login modal. Native Swift SDK for iOS/macOS with passkey support via ASAuthorizationController.

Website: https://authon.dev
Docs: https://docs.authon.dev
Dashboard: https://authon.dev/dashboard
GitHub: https://github.com/mikusnuz/authon-sdk

## SDKs

### JavaScript / TypeScript

| Package | Registry | Description |
|---------|----------|-------------|
| @authon/js | npm | Core browser SDK — ShadowDOM modal, OAuth, sessions |
| @authon/react | npm | Provider, hooks, and components for React |
| @authon/nextjs | npm | Middleware, server helpers, and React components for Next.js |
| @authon/vue | npm | Plugin, composables, and components for Vue 3 |
| @authon/nuxt | npm | Auto-imported composables and middleware for Nuxt 3 |
| @authon/svelte | npm | Stores and components for Svelte |
| @authon/angular | npm | Service, guard, and components for Angular |
| @authon/react-native | npm | Mobile authentication for React Native / Expo |
| @authon/shared | npm | Shared types and constants (internal, consumed by other SDKs) |

## Quick Install

```bash
# React
npm install @authon/react @authon/js

# Next.js
npm install @authon/nextjs @authon/js

# Vue 3
npm install @authon/vue @authon/js

# Nuxt 3
npm install @authon/nuxt @authon/js

# Svelte
npm install @authon/svelte @authon/js

# Angular
npm install @authon/angular @authon/js

# React Native / Expo
npm install @authon/react-native react-native-svg
```

## Core Concepts

- **Modal**: A ShadowDOM-based sign-in/sign-up modal rendered inside your page. Prevents CSS conflicts. Branding is fetched from your Authon dashboard and can be overridden via `appearance`.
- **Publishable Key**: Client-side key (`pk_live_...` or `pk_test_...`) used by browser and mobile SDKs. Safe to expose.
- **OAuth Providers**: Google, Apple, GitHub, Discord, Facebook, Microsoft, Kakao, Naver, LINE, X. Configured in the dashboard, auto-detected by SDKs.
- **Sessions**: Access token (15 min default TTL) + refresh token (7 days default TTL). Auto-refresh built into client SDKs. Max 5 concurrent sessions per user by default.
- **Webhooks**: HMAC-SHA256 signed events sent to your endpoint. Events: user.created, user.updated, user.deleted, user.banned, user.unbanned, session.created, session.rotated, session.ended, session.revoked, provider.linked, provider.unlinked.
- **IMPORTANT — User Sync**: If your app has its own database, you MUST register a webhook (user.created, user.updated, user.deleted) to sync Authon users to your DB. Without this, users who sign up via Authon won't appear in your app. See https://authon.dev/docs/webhooks/sync-users
- **Organizations**: Multi-tenant support with roles (owner, admin, member), invitations, and per-org settings.
- **MFA**: TOTP-based (Google Authenticator / Authy compatible) with backup codes.
- **Passkeys**: WebAuthn-based passwordless authentication. Register and authenticate with platform authenticators.
- **Web3**: EVM (MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase, Pexus, Trust) and Solana (Phantom) wallet authentication via sign-in-with-wallet.
- **Embedded Wallet**: `authon.wallet` (`@authon/js`) creates a non-custodial HD wallet per user (BIP39 seed in 2-of-3 shares: device, Authon, passkey PRF backup; EVM account at m/44'/60'/0'/0/0). API: get, ensure, signMessage, signTypedData, signTransaction, protect, restore({ resetOtherDevices? }), upgradeBackup, revokeDevice, provider(chainId) (EIP-1193), onChange. High-risk signatures (value/call data, approvals, permits) are approved in a top-level Authon window opened from the wallet frame; errors CONFIRM_WINDOW_BLOCKED/CONFIRM_WINDOW_CLOSED/MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE never sign. Config: `wallet: { origin?, autoCreate?, ui?, getToken? }` (getToken for BFF mode, minted with `createAuthonWalletToken` from `@authon/nextjs/server`). protect/restore must run inside a click handler. Enable per project in the console (Advanced > Embedded wallets).
- **Sign-in method enforcement**: methods turned off in the console are rejected by the API with `AUTH_METHOD_DISABLED`. Magic links are verified automatically on page load (`autoHandleMagicLink`, default true), but only silently in the browser that requested the link and only when nobody is signed in; otherwise the SDK fires `magicLinkConfirmationRequired({ email, reason })` and the app must ask "Sign in as {email}?" and call `confirmMagicLink()` (or `dismissMagicLink()`; state via `getPendingMagicLink()`). Links requested by the SDK carry the token in the URL fragment (`#authon_magic_link=1&token=...`) on every target, including the project's `/auth/verify`; only requests without the SDK browser value (older SDKs, raw API) still get `?token=`, which the SDK still reads. The API enforces the project's passwordless method (magic link vs 6-digit code) with `AUTH_METHOD_DISABLED`. Email codes: 5 tries per code (at most 3 from IPs that did not request it), short escalating waits on repeated failures (HTTP 429 `PASSWORDLESS_RETRY_LATER` + `retryAfter`), 3 sends per address per 10 minutes (`PASSWORDLESS_SEND_LIMITED`), no long lockout. Accounts with TOTP get `mfaRequired` (`AuthonMfaRequiredError`) from magic link, email code and Web3 sign-in just like password sign-in; finish with `verifyMfa()`. Passkey sign-in options never list an email's credentials (discoverable passkeys only).

## Security

- **Token storage**: browser mode (`sessionMode: 'browser'`, the default) stores the access and refresh tokens in `localStorage`, which any script on the origin can read. Refresh tokens are single-use (rotated on every refresh). For projects with embedded wallets, recommend `sessionMode: 'bff'`: tokens stay in the server's HttpOnly session, the SDK never touches browser token storage, and the wallet uses short-lived wallet-only tokens via `wallet.getToken` (`createAuthonWalletToken` from `@authon/nextjs/server`). See `docs/bff-authorization-code-pkce.md`.
- **Branding values**: the modal escapes branding and profile values. Terms/privacy URLs must be absolute http(s). The logo must be a base64 `data:image/(png|jpeg|gif|webp|svg+xml)` URL. Colors must be hex, rgb[a]() or hsl[a](). Custom CSS is capped at 20,000 characters and must not contain `</style`. The API rejects invalid values on save and drops them on read.

## Environment Variables

```env
# Client-side (browser / mobile)
NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTHON_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=pk_live_...    # Next.js
NUXT_PUBLIC_AUTHON_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=pk_live_...    # Nuxt
VITE_AUTHON_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=pk_live_...           # Vite-based apps
```
